definitions.short: Betser , a place in Palestine; also an Israelite
definitions.full: H1221. Betser II. בֶּ֫צֶר ( fortress ) — 1. proper name, of a location city in Reuben (MI בצר ) Deut 4:43 ; Josh 20:8 ; 1Chr 6:63 . 2. proper name, masculine person a descendant of Asher 1Chr 7:37 .
definitions.rootNote: the same as 1220 , an inaccessible spot;

occurrences.englishText: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
